scope: Groovydoc field declaration slots; issue 1666 Unit 2

reference.status: Source reading only; no Groovy tool installed or run
reference.same_row: The lexer hides block comments followed by code on the same row. Inventory groovy-constructor and groovy-field use that placement and ask for a document; their wording is not what the cited Groovy sources attach.

limitations: The pinned grammar 0.6.0 requires a same-line slashy closer; multi-line slashy openers recover with ERROR nodes. Groovy 4.0.32's lexer instead closes the slashy token at the first slash in /** doc */, so the apparent Groovydoc is not literal content of that first string.

l08-slashy-first-line.groovy: grammar recovery exposes /** doc */ and int x as a Groovydoc and clean field, and the collector resolves one document to field slot x. Groovy 4.0.32 reads the text as two slashy strings with intervening operators and no Groovydoc or x field. The resolved association is a pinned grammar/lexer limitation, not confirmed Groovy attachment.
A multi-line slashy string before a documented field can also swallow or withhold that later documentation when the grammar recovers differently (l09-slashy-before-field.groovy).
